🚫 Don't use a fixed rate to swap stablecoins. Here is why.

When you swap $USDC for $USDT, market volatility is practically zero. But if you choose a fixed rate, you are paying a built-in premium for a market risk that doesn't exist.

The choice between Fixed and Floating swap flows comes down to one thing: who takes the financial hit if the market moves while your deposit is confirming.

Fixed Rate: The Guarantee 🔒 

• The exact amount on your screen is 100% locked before you send anything.
• The exchange absorbs all the market risk (aka slippage).
• Downside: You pay a small hedging cost. This makes it perfect for fast-moving markets or slow-confirming coins like BTC, but a waste of money for stablecoins.

Floating Rate: The Market Ride 🏄

• Your final payout is calculated the exact moment your trade executes.
• It completely skips the risk premium, making it generally cheaper.
• Downside: The initial number is just an estimate. If the price drops before your funds arrive, your final payout drops too.

Helpful fact: On ChangeNOW, about half of all floating trades actually match the initial estimate. Instead of inflating quotes just to look better on aggregators, we pull real-time order books from multiple liquidity providers to give you the actual best rate.
